notes: Scenario table for crates/mien-core/tests/proxy_e2e.rs: real browser-equivalent HTTP traffic through the Mien shared engine into a real Xray server inbound and out into a loopback ECHO origin.
All UUIDs and passwords are synthetic test constants. Nothing here reaches a real node, and no fixture value is a usable credential.

The origin host name is generated per run from originHostTemplate so that neither the system resolver nor the test process can resolve it; only the controlled server Xray can, through its own dns.hosts table.

serverInboundUplinkBytes is a strictly-greater comparison against the growth the controlled server reports for its own inbound. The matching uplink growth is measured before and after the proxied request.
